notes.title: Update 24.01.2024.
notes.content:
A new update for your favorite game is finally out!

Here's what's been added:

[list]
[*] Added new items in the town where the player appears when starting the game
[*] Added new clouds
[*] Fixed errors in text and hints.
[*] Added new coloring for the appearance of passenger cars.
[*] Added several new characters to the train carriage
[*] Fixed a bug where a player could fall through the floor of the train car and end up on the street.
[/list]

If you liked the game, we are glad to inform you that development of a new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2757610/TransSiberian_Express/]Trans-Siberian Express[/url] has started.

notes.title: A major update of the Chinese Train Trip!
notes.content:
So, the game update is out!

What's been added and changed:
[list]
[*] New objects added to the route
[*] Slowed down time, so players can ride longer during the day on the train
[*] Improved lighting and shadows
[*] General optimization of the game
[/list]
